theme: recursive archive WALK MOVEALL EQFILE deep tree relocate+verify

tests.name: stage_eq
tests.cmd: COPYALL stage + EQFILE src/dst equal bytes=3

tests.name: eq_differ
tests.cmd: EQFILE a.plate other.txt → differ soft exit 0

tests.name: archive_moveall
tests.cmd: MOVEALL plates → archive flat; drop keeps other+c.log

weaknesses.title: WALK * includes directories; no files-only walk mode
weaknesses.detail: WALK_DIRS mixed into path bag. Agents must KEEPFILES after every unrestricted walk. No WALK --files-only / WALKFILES.
weaknesses.repro: WALK root * → sub + sub/deep dirs in bag

weaknesses.title: MOVEALL flattens basenames — deep tree structure lost on archive
weaknesses.detail: sub/b.plate and sub/deep/d.plate become archive/b.plate archive/d.plate. Same class as COPYALL. Collision if two same basenames at different depths.
weaknesses.repro: MOVEALL deep plates → dest basenames only

weaknesses.title: WALK leaves empty directory shells after MOVEALL of all files
weaknesses.detail: Archive relocates files but orphaned empty dirs remain under drop/. No RMDIRALL empty-tree prune.
weaknesses.repro: MOVEALL all plates; sub/deep still exists empty

weaknesses.title: FIND is string index; FINDALL is recursive walk — naming trap
weaknesses.detail: Agents expecting find(1) semantics from FIND get character index. FINDALL/WALK is the tree walk. Documented but high agent footgun.
weaknesses.repro: SYS FIND hay needle → index; SYS FINDALL root pat → paths

weaknesses.title: No bulk EQFILEALL path-bag pairwise compare
weaknesses.detail: Verify COPYALL needs EACH LINE + JOIN dest + EQFILE loop. No bag-to-bag content audit op.
weaknesses.repro: stage then verify all pairs manually

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON bag newline collapse
weaknesses.detail: Long WALK path bags truncate/collapse in JSON line.

weaknesses.title: WALK pattern is basename fnmatch only — no path-glob ** semantics
weaknesses.detail: Cannot match sub/**/*.plate vs top-level differently beyond full walk+FILTERGLOB.
weaknesses.repro: WALK root 'sub/*' may not do what shell does

workarounds: Use distinctive basenames or pre-check BASENAMEALL+FREQ for collisions
EQFILE after stage before archive (sources still present)
Prefer FINDALL name for walk; never use FIND for paths
Manual RMDIR empty parents after archive if needed
language_gaps: FIND rename or FINDSTR alias to reduce trap
issues_faced: WALK deep plates + MOVEALL + EQFILE positive path clean
Recursive vs PATHGLOB value prop confirmed
Empty dir shells left after archive
